comparison.objective: Align a robot link to its zero mark and insert a calibration pin; candidate removes a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Support a gravity-loaded link while aligning and pushing a pin home versus guide blades around a contact, depress tangs, and pull the wire.
comparison.success_condition: Link held at zero by the seated pin after release versus selected terminal fully extracted while connector remains serviceable.
comparison.reason: The calibration task tests load support plus insertion; the candidate tests selective latch release plus extraction.
